Messages.Author: Geb

hi

the action continues effect of the cards form of mist, or shadow body
mainteins the action modifiers previusly applied to the action? if a
blocking minion plays intercept cards and the action continues after
combat with that minion he lost the intercept?

example :)
minion A plays a leather jacket, minion B blocks with a spirit touch,
minion A plays a shadow play for +2 stealh, minion B responds with a
enhanced senses, minion A plays shroud of night for a +1 additional
stealth, minion B uses a KRCG radio to add +1 intercept. At last the
minion B blocks :), combat pass with a shadow play so the question is,
did the minion A who plays the shado body continue the action with the
+4 stealth? did the minion who is tapped for blocking succesfully at
+0 intercept if he untaps to block again? cant he minion plays more
modifiers such as shadow play to increase his stealth (he plays it in
the action, and i think is the same action again)?

the same with the form of mist, but that card adds a +1 stealth each
time he plays it in combat.

Geb
uh? another stealth card? no problem i have full of intercept :D

Messages.Body:
Geb wrote:

> the action continues effect of the cards form of mist, or shadow body
> mainteins the action modifiers previusly applied to the action? if a

Action modifiers apply for the duration of an action by default, yes.

> blocking minion plays intercept cards and the action continues after
> combat with that minion he lost the intercept?

No, as stated in [6.2.2.2]

> minion A plays a leather jacket, minion B blocks with a spirit touch,
> minion A plays a shadow play for +2 stealh, minion B responds with a

> +4 stealth? did the minion who is tapped for blocking succesfully at
> +0 intercept if he untaps to block again? cant he minion plays more

> the action, and i think is the same action again)?
>
> the same with the form of mist, but that card adds a +1 stealth each
> time he plays it in combat.

The stealth and intercept remain in effect. [6.2.2.2]

it's still the same action, you have the option to play action modifiers
again, but you can't use previously played action modifiers again. And don't
forget that form of mist (superior) cannot be played twice since it becomes
itself an action modifier.
